name: Day log Part D smoke test

definition.title: Day log Part D smoke test ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of Day log Part D — seeds, photos, guardrails, continuity (0132), shipped 2026-09-22. The API path was smoke-tested from the PC (photos, media routes, week block, memory index, the carry-over); this ticket is the human half: the prompt with seeds on the phone, a photo sent to the bot, the carry-over on a real second night, the review page. Phase 1 wants a real evening at the prompt. Tick as you go; anything that fails stays unticked with a comment naming the step id.

steps_definition.title: Day log Part D smoke test

intro.verdict_html: Three phases, one evening plus ten minutes the next day. Phase 1 is tonight at the prompt: the seeds line, a photo to the bot, a loose end left open on purpose. Phase 2 is the next night: the interviewer asks about that loose end, once. Phase 3 is the review page and the day page, any time.
prerequisites: Settings → Journal: the nightly prompt is ON and the seed toggles are on
Something on today's calendar, or at least the weather cache warm (open the dashboard once today)
The Telegram bot chat open on the phone

phases.title: Tonight at the prompt
phases.lede_html: Wait for the 21:30 prompt rather than starting from the page — the seeds are gathered when it fires.

steps.title: The prompt reads "Evening. Calendar had …" (and/or the weather, something you finished on Media) before "Talk, Quick or Skip?" — not the bare "How was the day?"
Tap Talk and answer. Then send a photo to the bot with no caption — it replies "📷 kept" and does NOT make a ticket. Send a second photo with a caption — the caption is answered like a message
Before you finish, say something unresolved that points at later — "we're going back on Saturday to …", "waiting to hear about …". Then "done" and the scores

fields.label: The loose end you left
fields.placeholder: going back Saturday for the lamp room

steps.title: Open today's day page. The seeds line sits under the heading; each photo is on the scene you were talking about when you sent it (drag none — check the strip under the scene); the captioned one carries its caption

fields.label: Which scene each photo landed on — right or wrong?

steps.title: At tomorrow's prompt, Talk. Its first or second question asks about the loose end from step 1.3 — once. It does not come up again that night, nor on any later night

fields.label: How it asked
fields.placeholder: Did you get to the lamp room on Saturday?

phases.title: The review page and the day page

steps.title: Weekly review → below the Tickets block, a Day log block: one row per day this week with its first line and score dots, the header counting logged and skipped with the score averages. A weekday opens that day

On a day page: + PHOTO in the Photos card uploads one from the phone or PC; a photo's caption edits in place; × removes it. Tap a photo — the full image opens (a signed link, so it expires after an hour)
The Boys → Ask: ask about something you said on a closed day this week — the answer draws on that day (source type daylog_day in the sources panel)
Ask Da Boi "what have I been up to this week?" — the answer draws on the last three day logs without you pasting anything
